enrichment method: we utilized TX-114 phase partitioning to fractionate Mp proteins into three fractions: a LAMP hydrophobic detergent phase, an aqueous phase (Aq) harboring mostly hydrophilic cytosolic proteins, and an insoluble phase (Ins) containing the insoluble triton shell and a spontaneously forming, phospholipid-rich precipitate.

instrument: coupled directly to a Q Exactive HF mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific) via electrospray ionization
ionization type: coupled directly to a Q Exactive HF mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific) via electrospray ionization
